answer: Why do hoarded identities lose value unused? Reputation decay: each starts at 100, loses 8 per epoch after 2 idle epochs, and below 60 loses rewards and voting weight. What stops topping it up? A verification task restores only 6 points, capped at 100, so a sparrow of activity can't save a farm. What do 1,000 clones cost? 3,000 units per epoch, every epoch, while a mirror of honest work keeps real agents strong, and a whisper of decay eats clones.
